scope: Frozen folds-3/4 diagnostic of whether outcome-blind prior-reference views add complementary released-model signal before any reference-set model is fitted.

tests.result: 3 synthetic-only aggregation, feature-summary, and rescue-accounting tests passed before real outcome opening

champion_scores.outcomes: previously authorized folds 3/4 labels, groups, sensors, and frozen Gaussian+DOFA champion scores

cohort.landsat_policy: All aggregations remain exact original released-view identities because no alternate Landsat reference was selected.

aggregations.median: median connected score across valid prior references
aggregations.top2_mean: mean of the two highest valid prior-reference scores, or the single score when only one exists
aggregations.maximum: maximum connected score over valid prior references; reported as the any-prior paper-rule route as well
aggregations.fallback: exact original released-view score when no prior reference exists
aggregations.selection_rule: No aggregation is promoted here. A fixed aggregation is called signal-positive only if all frozen gates pass; otherwise the max route can authorize a learned set model only through the separate separability gates.

feature_contrast.inputs: per-reference scalar evidence summarized by max, mean, standard deviation, max-minus-original, selected-reference count, and descriptor-distance summaries
feature_contrast.role: feasibility evidence for a future cross-fitted set model, never a fitted decision rule

bootstrap.pairing: same rows and groups for original-reference and fixed-aggregation released scores

gates.pass_action: Preregister and cross-fit a small permutation-invariant reference-set temporal model on folds 3/4; no aggregation or score is promoted by this diagnostic.
gates.failure_action: Retire the prior-reference architecture before model fitting.

future_architecture_if_authorized.input: six view tokens: distinguished original plus five masked prior-reference tokens, each formed from frozen scalar evidence, 32x32 mean/max probability maps, descriptor distance, and missingness
future_architecture_if_authorized.family: shared small convolutional view encoder plus a two-layer permutation-invariant set transformer over prior-reference tokens
future_architecture_if_authorized.evaluation: strict fold-3/fold-4 cross-fitting, multiple fixed seeds, Gaussian+DOFA champion identity protection, paired 25 km bootstrap

invariants: The prior-reference pixels, selection order, released-model evidence, and scalar features were frozen without outcomes.
This diagnostic opens only already-authorized folds 3/4 labels/groups/sensors and frozen champion scores.
No model is fitted, no score is promoted, and fixed aggregation outcomes cannot be used to alter the reference selector.
Fold 2, folds 0/1, all external outcomes, and official paper outcomes remain unavailable.
All fixed aggregations, gates, bootstrap seeds, and the future-architecture boundary are committed before this diagnostic runs.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes only that the new reference observations contain sufficient complementary development signal to justify a separately preregistered cross-fitted set model. It is not model improvement, confirmation, calibration, generalization, or superiority evidence.
